clues.clue: Showing some front — or rear?
In street, I mean to wait it out
Ariel became such a bohemian
Lawyer of singular kind
Laugh with companion and still drink
One not dreaming of only the past
A very well rigged sail in current novel
A novelist can or might give alternative to “chatty”
Bugs Bunny’s first performance — more weird talking
Budget speech abandoned by leader
Character witness
Out. I’m not so thrilled about that
Unforgettable time in base
Puts down in the correct order
Nurse pulled up underwear in time
Overlooking the cause of this?
Go on, settle up
Glib talk about twin cross breed of dog
Kid angry at sailor? You can bet on it
Author at home having caught disease on farm
Pound end of blade into solid weapon
Stir in?
Do one-eighty here and there in boat race
Stuff about Ulster by posh nutcase
A rocky gap, one near peak
Dance as a couple in Strictly
Monkey, a little chimpanzee
